title: Going Places
text:
Anna takes the bus to school every day. The bus stop is near her house. The bus is big and yellow. It leaves at seven fifteen in the morning.

On Sunday, Anna and her father go to the train station. They buy two tickets for the train to the city. The train is fast, and the trip takes one hour. Anna likes to look out of the window.

questions.text: How many tickets do Anna and her father buy?
Why does Anna probably get up early on school days?
options: She has to be at the bus stop before seven fifteen
She has a train to catch
She wants to see her father

questions.text: How does Anna probably feel about the train trip?
options: She is angry with her father

vocabulary.definition: a large vehicle that carries many people along a set route
a place where trains or buses stop so people can get on or off
small pieces of paper or cards that you need to travel
an opening with glass in a wall or vehicle, so you can see outside

paragraph_translations: Anna toma el autobús a la escuela todos los días. La parada de autobús está cerca de su casa. El autobús es grande y amarillo. Sale a las siete y cuarto de la mañana.
El domingo, Anna y su padre van a la estación de tren. Compran dos billetes para el tren a la ciudad. El tren es rápido y el viaje dura una hora. A Anna le gusta mirar por la ventana.
